name: Financial Ombudsman Service
notes: FRL within 6 months OR 8+ weeks with no response. FSCS is not an escalation of a living firm.

name: Energy Ombudsman
notes: Deadlock letter within 12 months OR 8 weeks unresolved.

name: Information Commissioner's Office
notes: ICO does not award damages. Pair with GDPR Art. 82 letter-before-claim if seeking compensation.

name: Financial Services Compensation Scheme
notes: Only if firm in default / ceased trading. Otherwise route to FOS.
